title: Bare postgresql:// URLs must be pinned to psycopg2 before engine creation
answers: MLflow server fails with ModuleNotFoundError no module named psycopg after upgrading SQLAlchemy to 2.1
postgresql backend store URI stopped working with SQLAlchemy 2.1
which psycopg driver does MLflow use for a postgresql:// tracking URI
body:
Symptom: After SQLAlchemy 2.1 is installed, an MLflow server or store started with a bare postgresql:// backend or tracking URI fails at engine creation with "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psycopg'".
Root cause: SQLAlchemy 2.1 maps the bare postgresql:// scheme to the psycopg3 driver, while the db extra shipped only psycopg2-binary, and the URI was passed through unchanged to sqlalchemy.create_engine in mlflow/store/db/utils.py:create_sqlalchemy_engine.
Fix pattern: Normalize a bare postgresql:// URL to postgresql+psycopg2:// before create_engine is called, and install both psycopg2-binary and psycopg[binary] in the db extra so either driver resolves.
Constraints: Only the bare scheme is rewritten; an explicit postgresql+psycopg:// or postgresql+psycopg2:// URI must pass through unchanged. Tests asserting the URL handed to create_engine (tests/store/db/test_utils.py:test_non_mysql_no_ssl_params and the tracking and model-registry get_store tests) must expect the normalized form.
applies: Any code path in MLflow that builds a SQLAlchemy engine from a user-supplied PostgreSQL URI; does not apply to SQLite or MySQL URLs.
says: The tracking server fails to start when configured with a standard PostgreSQL database address.
Connecting the tracking server to an existing PostgreSQL database crashes with a missing driver error.
Upgrading database libraries breaks server startup when using a standard Postgres tracking URI.
Allow the tracking server to connect to Postgres backends without requiring special driver prefixes.
Model registry server crashes on boot when pointed to a basic PostgreSQL database URL.
search: In mlflow/store/db/utils.py:create_sqlalchemy_engine, bare postgresql:// URLs must be normalized to postgresql+psycopg2:// before create_engine is called. This prevents SQLAlchemy 2.1 from mapping bare postgresql:// to the psycopg3 driver and failing with ModuleNotFoundError when only psycopg2-binary is present. Explicit postgresql+psycopg:// or postgresql+psycopg2:// URIs remain untouched, and the rule applies to any MLflow SQLAlchemy engine built from PostgreSQL URIs, excluding SQLite and MySQL.
